name: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd
title: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd - 500040 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 presales of INR 4,288 crores (+69% QoQ) and FY26 presales of INR 8,136 crores, but BD of only ~INR 1,600 crores in FY26 and no FY27 presales guidance leaves pipeline lumpy.

capex.quote: construction spend this year in '27 should be close to INR 1,000 crores

triggers.label: BD only INR 1,600 cr in FY26
triggers.quote: we have done just INR 1,600 crores last year

triggers.label: INR 15,000 cr launch target may slip to FY29
triggers.quote: it's quite possible that INR 15,000 crores instead of FY '28 may kind of slip over to FY '29

triggers.label: Payment plans extended in MMR
triggers.quote: So that's why we had to do some extensions in that market.

triggers.label: Q4 presales INR 4,288 cr, +69% QoQ
triggers.quote: We achieved presales of INR 4,288 crores, reflecting a robust 69% Q-o-Q increase.

guidance.value: No numeric guidance; new launches ~INR 9,000 cr plus ~INR 7,000 cr sustenance
guidance.quote: we have got about INR 9,000-plus crores of new launches and INR 7,000 crores of sustenance sales coming up
This year, we should be spending INR 1,200-odd crores for construction.
